title: Pan-Seared Skirt Steak with Stir Fry
description: A Japanese-inspired recipe featuring a pan-seared skirt steak served with a light stir fry.

ingredients.name: Skirt Steak
ingredients.notes: preferably flank steak or skirt steak

ingredients.name: Stir Fry Vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, carrots, and broccoli

instructions: 1. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Season the skirt steak with salt and pepper.
3. Add 1 tablespoon of sesame oil to the skillet and sear the skirt steak for 3-4 minutes per side.
4. Remove the skirt steak from the skillet and let it rest for 5 minutes.
5. In the same skillet, add 1 tablespoon of light soy sauce and stir to combine.
6. Add the stir fry vegetables to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
7. Slice the skirt steak against the grain and serve with the stir fry and green onions.
